source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States. Foreign tourist visits, 2024: India Tourism Statistics, Ministry of Tourism (Table 182). rounds.ask: Foreign tourist visits, twenty twenty-four: Rajasthan, or West Bengal?
rounds.tell: West Bengal. About fifty percent more.

rounds.ask: Which state produces more meat: Haryana, or Karnataka?
rounds.tell: Haryana. One and a half times.

rounds.ask: Which state exports more goods: Andhra Pradesh, or Madhya Pradesh?
rounds.tell: Andhra Pradesh. Two and a half times.
